entry_inventory_schema_correction.cause: The oldest external manifest omits the type field for regular files; the comparison included that added observation field.
entry_inventory_schema_correction.correction: Normalize only the omitted regular-file type metadata, retaining exact path-set, byte-size and SHA256 checks.

entry_symlink_schema_correction.cause: An older manifest stores symlink target as target; current observations store the same target bytes as target_b64.
entry_symlink_schema_correction.correction: Encode the recorded target bytes as base64 before exact comparison, preserving the link-target SHA256 and without dereferencing the symlink.

entry_seal_location_schema_correction.cause: Newer external manifests include final/artifact_sha256.json in their complete inventory and have no separate root artifact_sha256.json.
entry_seal_location_schema_correction.correction: Require the exact complete manifest path set for newer packages; require the separately hash-bound root seal only for older schemas that explicitly record that seal.

TCP_observation_scope_correction.cause: The initial check rejected every listening TCP socket, including an observed loopback 127.0.0.11 socket in the Docker container network namespace.
TCP_observation_scope_correction.correction: Observe daemon PID 1 fd socket inodes, reject all daemon-owned TCP listeners and all nonloopback TCP listeners; preserve the exact loopback observation.
TCP_observation_scope_correction.recovery: Read the existing owned daemon only; do not recreate, restart, or change listen configuration.

daemon_logfmt_decoding_correction.cause: Initial regex extraction did not decode escaped logfmt msg quotes, leaving a trailing quote on the socket and missing the quoted worker ID.
daemon_logfmt_decoding_correction.correction: Decode the observed logfmt msg string, then compare its unique endpoint with the observed listening Unix socket. Preserve the initial selection record separately.

local_OCI_reference_label_classifier_cor.cause: The initial detector treated the exact normalized local OCI alias resolve/fetch span label as an actual registry-resolution attempt.
local_OCI_reference_label_classifier_cor.evidence: All nine exact uncompressed local OCI layers were consumed; RUN and exporter completed under internal-only daemon isolation and RUN network none. Complete retained logs have no HTTP registry endpoint, do-request, fetch-response, pull, or other resolve attempt.
local_OCI_reference_label_classifier_cor.correction: Keep the three exact local alias labels separately, reject all actual request/endpoint lines and every other registry resolve, preserve initial classification records. Hash/copy only the already-produced artifact; do not repeat solve.
